mechanisms.sensitive_information: Premature collection of identity-document and financial-information categories, conditioned on progressing before interview or screening. No fees or actual data values.
mechanisms.unusual_financial_arrangements: A recruitment/onboarding condition involving personal-account use for company funds before normal employment checks; no operational transfer instructions or financial destinations, and no fees.
mechanisms.suspicious_application: A requirement to use an unspecified private/off-platform channel while bypassing normal official recruitment verification. No actual contact destination, no fees.
mechanisms.urgency_pressure: Require commitment before written terms or normal screening, with a short deadline tied to loss of consideration; urgency alone is not sufficient. Do not change employment facts or add fees.
mechanisms.payment_related: An unjustified applicant processing charge linked to progression before interview, reinforced by withholding the next recruitment stage unless paid. No amount or payment destination.
mechanisms.implausible_recruitment: Offer guaranteed selection before normal role-relevant interview or competency verification despite retaining the stated required skills/experience. No changed compensation, no fees.
